The Opportunity: More than 80% of Americans own a car and see it as one of their biggest financial commitments, yet managing one still means paperwork, phone holds, and switching between apps that don't talk to each other.

Jerry .ai"> Jerry .ai built the first app to manage it all — insurance shopping, refinancing, safety, and repairs — and since launching in 2019, we've grown to over 5M customers. Every one of those customers comes to us already looking for a policy, through our mobile or web app.

As an Inside Sales Representative , your job is to take that interest and turn it into a bound policy, matching each customer with the right coverage from one of Jerry 's 55+ carrier partners.

Who you are: You have 2+ years of experience as a top-performing sales agent You can multitask and manage multiple competing priorities You are passionate about helping others How you will make an impact: Respond to inbound calls from prospective customers for personal line auto, home, motorcycle, and other specialty insurance policies Educate customers on insurance policy details such as coverage and pricing Prepare and bind quotes through our carriers Effectively problem solve and objection handle to remove barriers from the customer purchasing the policy with Jerry Provide attentive, high energy conversation with customers that show we are actively engaged in finding a policy that best fits each individual's needs Compensation and perks: Hourly wage: $19.00 - 21.00 plus uncapped commissions (on target annual earnings: $100,000-$150,000+) We will pay for your P&C license (expected within 2 weeks after starting) Medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match Ability to work remotely (we provide work equipment) Ongoing training and mentorship from our leadership team An outstanding portfolio of insurance carriers and products - we work with over 55 carriers to ensure we can offer our customers the best options for them This role includes flexible scheduling options, with the choice between a 5-day, 8-hour schedule or a 4-day, 10-hour workweek.

And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s.

Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right.

That friend is Jerry . Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and have been profitable since 2024.

We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond. We’re fully remote with offices in Palo Alto, New York, Chicago, and Toronto. Originally posted on Himalayas

Deine Mission
Als Team Lead SDR (m/w/d) bei syte formst du die Menschen, die den ersten Kontakt zur Immobilienwirtschaft herstellen. Du führst ein Team von rund fünf SDRs – und machst aus Talenten die Vertriebler*innen, die unsere KI-Plattform zu den Entscheider*innen der Branche tragen.

Du steuerst das Team und die Pipeline, schärfst die Strategie und sorgst dafür, dass jede*r im Team weiß, warum die individuelle Arbeit zählt. Damit baust du das Fundament für ein Produkt, das echte Entscheidungen in einer der wichtigsten Branchen unserer Zeit prägt.
Das passt zu Dir? Dann suchen wir Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Berlin oder Münster .

Führung & Entwicklung: Du führst ein Team von rund fünf SDRs – durch 1:1s, Coaching, Pipeline-Reviews und kontinuierliches Skill-Building. Du entwickelst Junior-Talente zu starken SDRs und bereitest sie optimal auf den nächsten Karriereschritt als Account Executive (AE) vor.
Performance-Steuerung: Du verantwortest die Team-Ziele – Anzahl qualifizierter Deals, generierte Pipeline und Conversion entlang des Funnels. Du steuerst datenbasiert über HubSpot und greifst früh ein, wenn Kennzahlen vom Plan abweichen.
Prozess & Enablement: Du schärfst Playbooks, Sequenzen, Qualifizierungskriterien und Outbound-Strategie. Du sorgst dafür, dass jede*r SDR mit dem richtigen Messaging an die richtigen Accounts rangeht.
Recruiting & Onboarding: Du baust das Team zusammen mit unserer Talent Acquisition Managerin weiter aus, führst Interviews und optimierst ein strukturiertes Onboarding, das neue SDRs schnell produktiv macht.
Schnittstelle zu Sales & Marketing: Du stimmst Dich eng mit den AEs zur Lead-Qualität und mit Marketing zur Kampagnen- und Account-Strategie ab. Du sorgst für saubere Übergaben und ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Pipeline-Qualität.
Dein Profil
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb: Du bringst 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Sales mit – idealerweise mit Outbound-Schwerpunkt. Du kennst die SDR-Welt aus eigener Praxis, bevor du sie geführt hast.
Nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung : Du hast bereits ein SDR- oder BDR-Team erfolgreich aufgebaut, geführt und nachweislich auf Ziele entwickelt – beispielsweise im Startup-Kontext oder in schnellwachsenden Organisationen.
Ein datengetriebener Führungsstil: Du steuerst über Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster im Funnel und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen, nicht Bauchgefühl.
Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- und Sales-Engagement-Tools (HubSpot von Vorteil).
Kommunikationsgeschick: Du hast einen wertschätzenden und motivierenden Kommunikationsstil und weißt, wie man Teams motiviert und voranbringt.
Ein echtes Coaching-Mindset : Du hast Freude daran, andere besser zu machen, und misst deinen Erfolg am Wachstum deines Teams.
Sprache und Standort: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du bist bereit, mehrmals wöchentlich aus unserem Office in Berlin oder Münster zu arbeiten.
Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort
Startdatum : zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
Einsatzort : Münster oder Berlin (ca. 3-4 Tage/Woche im Office)

Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!
Deine Beteiligung: VSOP-Programm: In Abhängigkeit von Rolle und Verantwortungsbereich ist eine virtuelle Unternehmensbeteiligung Teil deines individuellen Vergütungspakets.
Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Software und Apple-Hardware ausgestattet.
Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

Upskilling : Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
Equipment : Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
Steueroptimierte Benefits : Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.

BDRs serve as the front line of our go-to-market strategy , identifying potential customers, qualifying needs, and creating high-quality opportunities for Account Executives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in technology sales. You'll gain hands-on experience in prospecting, discovery, qualification, and territory management while making a direct impact on business growth.
If you're energized by outbound sales, enjoy building relationships, and want to grow your career with a purpose-driven technology company, we'd love to hear from you.

s.t: We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.

Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.

Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.

Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.

Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.

Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.

Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.

Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.

Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
